alt: Tonsils + adenoids - locations within Waldeyer's lymphatic ring guarding the entrance to the upper aerodigestive tract. Adenoid (pharyngeal tonsil) at the back of the nasopharynx; palatine tonsils at the sides of the oropharynx; lingual tonsil at the back of the tongue. (Blausen Medical CC BY 3.0)
